16.1.en: Divine qualities: fearlessness, a clean heart, steady practice, generosity, self-control, study and honesty.
16.1.hi: Divya gun: nidarta, saaf dil, lagataar practice, daan, self-control, padhai aur imaandaari.

16.2.en: Non-violence, truth, no anger, letting go, peace, no gossip, kindness to all, no greed, gentleness.
16.2.hi: Ahimsa, sach, gussa nahi, chhodna, shaanti, chugli nahi, sabpe daya, laalach nahi, narmi.

16.3.en: Energy, forgiveness, courage, purity, no hate and no big ego. These are signs of a divine nature.
16.3.hi: Josh, kshama, himmat, shuddhta, nafrat nahi aur bada ego nahi. Ye divya nature ke sign hain.

16.4.en: Showing off, arrogance, ego, anger, rudeness and ignorance are signs of a toxic nature.
16.4.hi: Dikhawa, ghamand, ego, gussa, badtameezi aur agyaan, ye toxic nature ke sign hain.

16.5.en: Divine qualities set you free; toxic ones trap you. Relax, Arjuna, you've got the good kind.
16.5.hi: Divya gun free karte hain, toxic gun phansate hain. Relax Arjun, tumhare paas achhe wale hain.

16.6.en: There are two types of people: divine and toxic. You've heard about the divine. Now the other side.
16.6.hi: Do tarah ke log hain: divya aur toxic. Divya ke baare mein sun liya. Ab dusra side.

16.7.en: Toxic people don't know what to do or what to avoid. No integrity, no discipline, no truth.
16.7.hi: Toxic log nahi jaante kya karna hai, kya nahi. Na integrity, na discipline, na sach.

16.8.en: They say: "Nothing's real, there's no God, life is random and it's all about desire."
16.8.hi: Woh kehte hain: "Kuch real nahi, Bhagwan nahi, life random hai aur sab bas chahat ke liye hai."

16.9.en: With that mindset they lose themselves and do harmful things that damage the world.
16.9.hi: Is soch se woh khud ko kho dete hain aur aise kaam karte hain jo duniya ko nuksaan pahunchate hain.

16.10.en: Endless desires, shady money, ego and showing off. That's how they live.
16.10.hi: Kabhi na khatam hone wali chahatein, galat paisa, ego aur dikhawa. Aise jeete hain.

16.11.en: They worry endlessly until death, and believe pleasure is the only point of life.
16.11.hi: Woh maut tak bina ruke chinta karte hain, aur maante hain ki maza hi life ka point hai.

16.12.en: Trapped by a hundred hopes, ruled by desire and anger, they grab money any way they can.
16.12.hi: Sau umeedon mein phanse, chahat aur gusse ke ghulaam, kisi bhi tarah paisa jodte hain.

16.13.en: "I got this today, I'll get that tomorrow. This is mine, and that'll be mine too." Never enough.
16.13.hi: "Aaj ye mila, kal woh milega. Ye mera hai, woh bhi mera hoga." Kabhi kaafi nahi.

16.14.en: "I destroyed that rival, I'll take down the rest. I'm the boss, I'm winning, I'm powerful."
16.14.hi: "Us rival ko khatam kiya, baakiyon ko bhi karunga. Main boss hoon, main jeet raha hoon, main powerful hoon."

16.15.en: "I'm rich and well-connected. Who's like me? I'll donate and party." Clout chasing, ancient edition.
16.15.hi: "Main ameer hoon, connections wala. Mere jaisa kaun? Daan karunga, party karunga." Clout chasing, purana version.

16.16.en: Lost in a hundred thoughts, stuck in a web of illusion, hooked on pleasure, they fall hard.
16.16.hi: Sau khayalon mein khoye, maya ke jaal mein phanse, mazon ke addict, woh buri tarah girte hain.

16.17.en: Full of themselves and drunk on money and pride, they do good deeds only for show.
16.17.hi: Apne aap mein mast, paise aur ghamand ke nashe mein, achhe kaam bhi sirf dikhawe ke liye karte hain.

16.18.en: Driven by ego, power, pride, lust and anger, they end up hating the divine in themselves and others.
16.18.hi: Ego, power, ghamand, vaasna aur gusse se chal ke, woh apne aur dusron ke andar ke divine se nafrat karte hain.

16.19.en: Cruel, hateful people keep getting pulled back into toxic cycles. What you give, you get.
16.19.hi: Kroor, nafrat bhare log baar-baar toxic cycles mein kheeche jaate hain. Jo doge, wahi paoge.

16.20.en: Life after life they sink lower, never reaching me.
16.20.hi: Janam dar janam woh aur neeche girte hain, mujh tak kabhi nahi pahunchte.

16.21.en: Lust, anger and greed: the three doors to self-destruction. Close all three.
16.21.hi: Vaasna, gussa aur laalach: khud ko barbaad karne ke teen darwaaze. Teeno band karo.

16.22.en: Escape those three and you start working for your own real good, and you reach the highest.
16.22.hi: In teeno se bacho toh apne asli bhale ke liye kaam karte ho, aur sabse ooncha paate ho.

16.23.en: Ignore all guidance and just follow your cravings? You get no success, no happiness and no freedom.
16.23.hi: Saari guidance ignore karke bas cravings follow karo? Na success, na khushi, na freedom.

16.24.en: So let wisdom be your guide on what to do and what not to do, and then act.
16.24.hi: Toh kya karna hai aur kya nahi, ismein gyaan ko apna guide banao, phir kaam karo.
